text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Machitan! Thank you sooo 
much for being born~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So, how was the cake? I did taste-test it 
as I went, just in case.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I was this close to screaming out, 
"Mmm-mm! This is soooo delicious!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And the little monster drawn with the 
chocolate pen! It looked so soft and 
fluffy, it was super cute.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, the look in her eyes is dead 
serious and full of drive! It's kind of a 
face that makes you want to cheer her 
on...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, that monster is "Machinodon"! I 
came up with it myself!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Yup, modeled after Machitan! Machinodon 
is a comforting kaiju who gives back all 
the kindness received from everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Still, when push comes to shove, you dig 
your heels in. That's just the kind of 
person you are, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
For both of you to think of me like 
that...! Such, such an incredible cake—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! I ate it all already~~! I wanted to 
stay with it longer~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhh! You're even gentle to the cake~~! 
You really are the true Machinodon!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't both of you start crying! 
That's twice as loud! I'll make you more, 
alright?
